description: Marine family conformance vectors. Every file is cf32_le SigMF, synthetic, generated by a test-signal generator and checked through an independent bit-level decoder. Times are seconds from the first sample. See specs/marine.md section 10 for how each one is run.

vectors.layout: AIS 1 (161.975 MHz) at -25 kHz, AIS 2 (162.025 MHz) at +25 kHz of the file centre
vectors.signal: 14 bursts, 0.1 s apart starting at 0.10 s, alternating A, B, A, ... Burst carrier offsets cycle 0, +400, -400 Hz (burst 1: 0 Hz is not guaranteed; any offset within +-400 Hz). SNR 25 dB in 48 kHz.
vectors.checked_by: content as transmitted; the payloads are the public example sentences of the gpsd AIVDM document

bursts.name: CHINA ROSE MURPHY EXPRESS ALERT
bursts.expect: rejected at the line layer: 346 bits is not a whole number of octets, and an HDLC frame (ISO/IEC 13239, ITU-R M.1371-5 Annex 2) carries whole octets; no frame, no station, no sentence, and not a bad FCS (the MMSI 123456789 is not a plausible M.585 identity either)

expect.note: The !AIVDM sentences the receiver writes must match the 'nmea' strings exactly, except the sequential message id of the two-part type 5 (any 0-9) and therefore its checksum. Station 271041815 combines both parts of message 24 (name PROGUY, call sign TC6163, type 60).

vectors.layout: FSK centre (dial) at 0 Hz; B (mark, the higher tone) at +85 Hz, Y at -85 Hz
vectors.signal: SITOR-B FEC mode, 100 Bd, 6 s of idle signal then one message, then the loop restarts. SNR 20 dB in 3 kHz.
vectors.checked_by: decoded back through an independent SITOR-B decoder

message.subject: A
message.text:
011200 UTC JAN 30
TEST VECTOR FOR A SITOR-B RECEIVER.
POSITION 12-34.5N 012-34.5E, FIGURES 0123456789.

expect.allowed_extra: one incomplete message with header XA01 at the very end (the loop restarted; the file ends inside it)

vectors.layout: FSK centre (dial) at 0 Hz; Y (1) is the lower tone (-85 Hz), B (0) the higher (+85 Hz)
vectors.signal: Four calls in a loop, 100 Bd; the file holds 40 s. SNR 20 dB in 3 kHz.
vectors.checked_by: decoded back through an independent M.493 decoder

vectors.layout: FM carrier at 0 Hz; AFSK 1300 Hz = Y (1), 2100 Hz = B (0), 1200 Bd
vectors.signal: The same four calls as dsc_mfhf_12k with VHF contents, looping; 8 s, the first call repeats at the end. C/N 25 dB in 12.5 kHz.
vectors.checked_by: decoded back through an independent M.493 decoder

vectors.layout: Upper sideband from the dial at 0 Hz: black 1500 Hz, white 2300 Hz above the dial
vectors.signal: Start tone 300 Hz for 5 s, 10 s of phasing lines, one white line, 40 picture lines of the synthetic chart (fax_chart_sent.pgm, 1809 x 40), stop tone 450 Hz for 5 s, then black. 49 s. SNR 25 dB in 3 kHz.
vectors.checked_by: decoded back through an independent fax decoder

expect.first_row: the white line after the phasing: no pixel below 128
expect.picture_rows_vs_chart: row r+1 of the picture against row r of fax_chart_sent.pgm, Pearson correlation over the rows with contrast, mean at least 0.55 (0.64 measured), no horizontal shift beyond 3 px

vectors.layout: NFM carrier at 0 Hz with a +300 Hz carrier error
vectors.signal: Transmissions of 0.8 s voice (tones), 0.04 s silent carrier, then the ATIS burst (20 dot bits, phasing, format 121 twice, five identity symbols, EOS 127, check symbol), 0.6 s gap. Five identities in turn; 12 s. C/N 30 dB in 12.5 kHz.
vectors.checked_by: decoded back through an independent M.493 decoder

vectors.layout: ASM 1 (161.975 MHz) at +75 kHz, ASM 2 (162.025 MHz) at +125 kHz, the 100 kHz VDE-TER channel of 161.8 MHz at -100 kHz
vectors.signal: 0.6 s. ASM bursts: 0.05 s on ASM 1, 0.15 s on ASM 2. VDE-TER bursts of 30 ms: 0.25 s 25 kHz pi/4-QPSK in sub-channel 0, 0.35 s 50 kHz 8PSK in sub-channels 1-2, 0.45 s 100 kHz 16QAM. SNR 25 dB (25 kHz burst power to noise in 25 kHz).

expect.note: Sub-channel k of a 100 kHz channel is centred at centre - 37.5 kHz + 25 kHz * k. The second ASM payload is not an AIS message (first six bits 0): it is listed with its hex only.

data_files.marine_vhf_channels.json: The five regional marine VHF channel plans (section 8.2 of the spec).
data_files.fax_chart_sent.pgm: The 1809 x 40 grey chart the fax vector transmits (P5 PGM).
